description: Inspect concealed plate fiducials, then keep their matching moving guides registered using inertial handles across action-paced paper beats.
name: Wonky Text Under Hostile Rendering V3 · Difficulty 3 · Simplified Interaction
natural_language: Each plate has two moving guides, marked with a dot or diamond; one is a reflected ghost. Sweep the loupe over each covered plate sleeve to find its true registration stamp. Discovered stamps stay visible. Inspect and prepare before START PRESS; inspection never consumes a press beat. Keep each solid handle's cross inside the guide matching that plate's stamp. The short trail shows recent drift; the dotted line and small bead show the next 600 ms. The square is your commanded position: the solid handle follows with inertia. After you deliberately control every plate once, one fixed 600 ms registration beat runs; waiting between beats does not move the paper. Clean exposure accumulates only while all crosses are inside their rings; paper keeps feeding otherwise. Color separation outside a ring permanently spoils the paper. Finish 24 seconds of clean exposure within 40 seconds, before the spoil gauge fills. There is one attempt; an early submission ends it.
